Bespoke, Handmade Wedding Invitations and Stationery

Adding luxury and timeless elegance to your wedding day with handwritten calligraphy and watercolour illustrations.

Handwritten Calligraphy

Beautifully handwritten calligraphy adds a sense of elegance and luxury to your wedding invitations and stationery. I will work with you to find a style that fits your personality and theme exactly. With no two pieces the same, handwritten calligraphy gives a your guests a truly unique, one-of-a-kind memento to remember your special day.

Watercolour Wedding Venue Illustration

An illustration of the picturesque, historic setting of your wedding makes the perfect centrepiece for your wedding invitations and stationery. I already work with a number of historic venues and castles as a recommended supplier.

Handmade, Artisan Papers and Inks

I work with a number of artisan suppliers for handmade, eco-friendly materials. Choose from a wide range of unique papers and inks to perfectly tie in with your wedding’s unique style and theme, creating an even more bespoke look.

All the Little Details

I offer a variety of finishing touches to complement your wedding invitations: organically dyed silk or velvet ribbons and tassels, envelope liners or invitation’s vellum jackets closed by a personalised wax seal or hand torn edges; together we’ll create an unforgettable experience for your guests.
